description:
## What

How does pkix-policy-zlint expose zlint's findings as workspace `Lint` impls?

## Options

- **A) One workspace `Lint` per zlint check.** ~700 `Lint` instances. Each cabf-br-tls / cabf-br-smime / cabf-cs check becomes a separate Rust `Lint` struct. Pro: 1:1 mapping with zlint's catalog; consumer can include/exclude individual checks; severity / rationale per-check; matches workspace's existing per-Lint pattern. Con: 700 instances to register; `LintRunner::new()` startup cost; many small types.

- **B) Umbrella `Lint` per profile family.** Three or four `Lint` impls (CabfTlsBrLint, CabfSmimeBrLint, CabfCsBrLint, optionally an all-CABF umbrella). Each invokes zlint internally with its profile-family filter; emits a single rolled-up finding or a `Vec<Finding>` inside one `Lint`. Pro: small surface, low startup cost. Con: consumer can't easily include/exclude individual zlint checks; loses 1:1 catalog correspondence.

- **C) Hybrid: umbrella by default, individual Lints opt-in.** Ship the umbrella (B) as the primary entry point; provide a builder / factory that materializes the per-check (A) instances on demand for callers who need per-check control. Best ergonomics, most surface, most complexity.

## Considerations

- Workspace's existing pattern: each `Lint` is one rule. Matches (A).
- zlint's catalog evolves; new checks land regularly. (A) means refresh-time pressure on Lint impl registration. (B) absorbs new checks transparently.
- Cache-friendliness (non-negotiable #6): `Finding` is per-check; a Vec<Finding> from one umbrella `Lint` is fine but loses some grain.
- pkix-policy-pkilint (sibling) faces the same question and probably wants the same shape.

## Decision-gate

Probably blocks pkix-policy-zlint implementation start. Surface when PKIX-jy95.1 (when it's filed as a child) begins.

## Cross-references

- PKIX-jy95 (parent epic, comment thread captures the broader context)
- PKIX-hbzo.1 (zlint+pkilint as differential oracles; granularity question echoes here)
title: Decide lint granularity for pkix-policy-zlint: one Lint per zlint check or umbrella Lint per profile family
